title: Don't Get Lost in the Trees: Streamlining LLM Reasoning by Overcoming Tree Search Exploration Pitfalls
authors_zh: Ante Wang、Linfeng Song、Ye Tian、Dian Yu、Haitao Mi、Xiangyu Duan、Zhaopeng Tu、Jinsong Su、Dong Yu
paper_type_zh: 推理时树搜索与过程价值建模研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计测试时搜索轨迹、状态合并和 verifier 反馈的读者
one_line: FETCH reduces redundant tree expansion by clustering equivalent reasoning states and stabilizes verifier-guided search with TD-trained, ensembled scores.
FETCH 合并语义等价推理状态，并以 TD(λ) 训练且集成的 verifier 分数引导树搜索，从而减少冗余扩展与评分方差。
why: It identifies the internal trace objects and score variance that determine whether additional test-time search compute is useful, while exposing missing rollout and label-release evidence.
inclusion_reason: FETCH makes the state, similarity signal, verifier score, and tree-selection mechanism explicit, making it a strong Track 5 test-time search record despite incomplete raw-trace release.

title: Problem
问题
html: Verifier-guided tree search can spend substantial compute without proportionate gains. FETCH separates two failure modes: over-exploration, where independently sampled nodes express semantically equivalent reasoning and are expanded repeatedly; and under-exploration, where high-variance verifier scores cause frequent trajectory switching or trap search on a locally attractive branch. The relevant data object is a search trace containing a problem, partial reasoning states, expansions, semantic-equivalence decisions, verifier scores, cluster membership, and a final answer—not merely the benchmark question and answer. FETCH is a search framework; the paper and repository do not establish that complete rollout trees are released as a reusable corpus.

verifier 引导的树搜索可能消耗大量计算，却没有获得相称收益。FETCH 区分两类失败：其一是过度探索，即独立采样的节点表达语义等价的推理，却被重复扩展；其二是探索不足，即高方差 verifier 分数导致频繁切换轨迹，或使搜索停留在局部高分分支。相关数据对象不是单纯的基准题目与答案，而是包含问题、部分推理状态、扩展、语义等价判断、verifier 分数、聚类归属和最终答案的搜索轨迹。FETCH 是搜索框架；论文与仓库都未证明完整 rollout 树已作为可复用语料公开。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: FETCH adds two orthogonal components to Best-First, Beam, Tree Search, or MCTS. After expansion, a fine-tuned SimCSE encoder represents new reasoning states and agglomerative clustering merges nearby states into hyper-nodes; the hyper-node score is aggregated from its member-node verifier scores, and later expansion rotates through member nodes by score. Separately, verifier training replaces pure Monte Carlo targets with bounded adjusted TD(λ) returns, while inference can average several verifier predictions. The feedback contract therefore combines outcome-derived scalar value estimates with learned semantic-equivalence decisions. Neither signal is an oracle process label: clustering can merge logically distinct states, and a lower-variance value estimate can still be systematically wrong.

FETCH 向 Best-First、Beam、Tree Search 或 MCTS 加入两个正交组件。节点扩展后，微调过的 SimCSE 编码新推理状态，凝聚层次聚类把邻近状态合并为超节点；超节点分数由成员节点的 verifier 分数聚合，后续扩展再按分数顺序选择成员。另一部分在训练时用有界的调整后 TD(λ) return 替代纯 Monte Carlo 目标，在推理时可平均多个 verifier 的预测。因此，其反馈契约由结果诱导的标量价值估计与学习得到的语义等价判断共同构成。二者都不是 oracle 式过程标签：聚类可能合并逻辑不同的状态，较低方差的价值估计也仍可能存在系统性错误。

title: Method
方法
html:
The embedding model can be post-trained from two kinds of state-pair supervision. A prompting route asks a general LLM whether two reasoning states are equivalent. A consistency route swaps states and compares their effect on sampled subsequent actions, then thresholds that difference into same/different labels. Standard cross-entropy training aligns cosine similarity with those labels. For GSM8K and GSM-Plus, the policy and value network are fine-tuned from Llama-3-8B on GSM8K; the value-network setup samples 16 initial-state rollouts per question at temperature 1.0. For MATH, the study uses a Mistral-7B-based policy and a PRM from prior work.

At inference, each expansion produces child states, their embeddings and verifier scores; clustering creates hyper-nodes, search chooses among hyper-nodes, and member states are expanded in verifier-score order. The paper evaluates four search algorithms on GSM8K, one sampled GSM-Plus variant per original case, and MATH500. A reproducible exported record would need the source split, prompt, full state text, parent/child edges, embedding-model revision, pair label or clustering distance, threshold, member list, raw and aggregate verifier scores, TD target provenance, expansion budget, decoding settings, and final answer. The official repository supplies code and an example JSONL, but complete trees, rejected states, state-pair training records, verifier targets, and per-run seeds are not confirmed as released.

嵌入模型可由两类状态对监督进行后训练。提示式路线让通用 LLM 判断两个推理状态是否等价；一致性路线交换状态，比较它们对后续采样动作的影响，再用阈值生成相同/不同标签，最后用交叉熵使余弦相似度拟合这些标签。GSM8K 与 GSM-Plus 设置中，policy 和 value network 从 Llama-3-8B 出发并在 GSM8K 上微调；value network 每题仅从初始状态以温度 1.0 采样 16 条 rollout。MATH 设置则采用既有的 Mistral-7B policy 与 PRM。

推理时，每次扩展产生子状态、嵌入和 verifier 分数；聚类建立超节点，搜索在超节点之间选择，再按 verifier 分数顺序扩展成员状态。论文在 GSM8K、每个原题随机抽取一个变体的 GSM-Plus，以及 MATH500 上评估四种搜索算法。可复现的导出记录至少应保留源划分、提示、完整状态文本、父子边、嵌入模型版本、状态对标签或聚类距离、阈值、成员列表、原始与聚合 verifier 分数、TD 目标来源、扩展预算、解码设置和最终答案。官方仓库提供代码与示例 JSONL，但完整搜索树、被拒状态、状态对训练记录、verifier 目标和逐次运行种子均未被证实已发布。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports answer accuracy and average generated-token cost across Best-First, Beam, Tree Search, and MCTS. State merging generally reduces token use; for example, the reported GSM8K Best-First setting falls from 2.47 to 0.88 in the paper's normalized token metric. TD(λ) training and verifier ensembling improve several accuracy results, and ablations compare pretrained versus post-trained SimCSE, clustering choices, and variance-reduction components. Human evaluation is used to compare embedding similarity with judgments.

These are system-level checks of search behavior. They do not establish that every merged pair is logically equivalent, every value target is calibrated, or every retained trace is suitable for training. Some configurations increase computation on MATH, and ensembling requires multiple verifiers. Benchmark accuracy and token savings motivate auditing the construction recipe; they are not data-quality proof for an unreleased rollout corpus.

论文在 Best-First、Beam、Tree Search 与 MCTS 上报告答案准确率和平均生成 token 成本。状态合并通常降低 token 使用，例如 GSM8K 的 Best-First 设置在论文归一化 token 指标上由 2.47 降至 0.88。TD(λ) 训练和 verifier 集成改善了多项准确率结果；消融还比较预训练与后训练 SimCSE、不同聚类方法及方差降低组件，并以人工评价检查嵌入相似度与判断的一致性。

这些属于搜索系统层面的检查，不能证明每个合并状态对都逻辑等价、每个价值目标都校准良好，也不能证明每条保留轨迹适合训练。部分 MATH 配置会增加计算，集成也需要多个 verifier。基准准确率与 token 节省说明构造配方值得审计，但不是未公开 rollout 语料的数据质量证明。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Tree search, PRM/value guidance, state embeddings, TD learning, and verifier ensembles all predate FETCH. Its distinctive contribution is to treat redundant-state expansion and score-induced trajectory switching as separate inefficiencies, then combine state-pair supervision, post-trained semantic clustering, hyper-node search, adjusted TD(λ) targets, and inference-time ensembling in a plug-in wrapper. For trace-data curation, this makes two often-hidden decisions explicit: which partial states were considered equivalent, and how multiple value estimates determined the next expansion. The paper does not propose a new human-annotated process dataset or a generally valid equivalence oracle.

树搜索、PRM/value 引导、状态嵌入、TD 学习与 verifier 集成都早于 FETCH。其区别在于把冗余状态扩展与分数引起的轨迹切换视为两类独立低效，再把状态对监督、后训练语义聚类、超节点搜索、调整后 TD(λ) 目标和推理时集成组合为可插拔框架。对轨迹数据整理而言，这使两个常被隐藏的决策变得显式：哪些部分状态被视为等价，以及多个价值估计如何决定下一次扩展。论文没有提出新的人工过程标注数据集，也没有建立普遍有效的状态等价 oracle。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Semantic similarity is not logical equivalence. A sentence encoder may ignore numbers or operators, prompting labels inherit judge-model errors, and consistency labels depend on the sampled continuation policy and thresholds. Agglomerative clustering makes irreversible grouping decisions; an incorrect merge can remove a genuinely distinct route, while an overly strict threshold leaves redundancy unchanged. Hyper-node aggregation can also conceal disagreement among member states.

TD(λ) trades variance for bias rather than producing ground truth, and averaging correlated verifiers does not remove shared errors. The reported compute metric is generated tokens, not full wall-clock or hardware cost; embedding, clustering, and parallel verifier overhead must be counted separately. Evaluation is limited to math benchmarks and specific model/search configurations. Complete rollout trees, rejected candidates, embedding supervision, reward targets, answer-normalization rules, decontamination records, licenses for derived artifacts, and reproducible per-run manifests remain unknown or incomplete.

语义相似不等于逻辑等价。句向量模型可能忽略数字或运算符；提示式标签继承 judge 模型错误；一致性标签又依赖采样 continuation policy 与阈值。凝聚层次聚类会作出难以撤销的合并：错误合并可能删除真正不同的路径，阈值过严则保留原有冗余；超节点聚合还可能掩盖成员状态之间的分歧。

TD(λ) 只是用偏差交换方差，不会产生 ground truth；平均相关 verifier 也无法消除共有错误。论文的主要计算指标是生成 token，而不是完整墙钟或硬件成本，嵌入、聚类和并行 verifier 的开销需要另计。评估局限于数学基准及特定模型/搜索配置。完整 rollout 树、被拒候选、嵌入监督、奖励目标、答案规范化规则、去污染记录、衍生制品许可与逐次运行清单仍为 unknown 或不完整。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
FETCH is useful as a schema for search-policy and verifier audits. A reusable trace should preserve the prompt and split, every raw state and edge, state-pair supervision source, embedding and clustering revisions, distance threshold, hyper-node membership, member and aggregate scores, TD/Monte-Carlo target, selected expansion, termination reason, answer check, token count, and random seed. With those fields, researchers can measure redundant expansion, false merges, verifier variance, trajectory switching, and compute allocation separately.

The recipe may also generate SFT or verifier-training material after independent correctness and provenance checks. The repository's toy example is useful for interface inspection but insufficient to claim a released dataset. Downstream benchmark improvements establish a system use case; they do not replace record-level validation, licensing review, or contamination analysis.

FETCH 可作为搜索策略与 verifier 审计的记录模式。可复用轨迹应保留提示与划分、每个原始状态和边、状态对监督来源、嵌入与聚类版本、距离阈值、超节点成员、成员及聚合分数、TD/Monte-Carlo 目标、被选扩展、终止原因、答案检查、token 数和随机种子。具备这些字段后，才能分别测量冗余扩展、错误合并、verifier 方差、轨迹切换和算力分配。

经过独立的正确性与血缘检查后，该配方也可能产生 SFT 或 verifier 训练材料。仓库中的 toy 示例适合检查接口，但不足以声称完整数据集已经发布。下游基准提升说明系统使用场景成立，却不能替代逐记录验证、许可证审查与污染分析。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Distinguish raw reasoning states, clustered hyper-nodes, and selected trajectories; they are different data objects.
  • Audit state-pair labels and false merges, especially changes to numbers, operators, or assumptions that remain textually similar.
  • Keep Monte Carlo targets, adjusted TD(λ) targets, individual verifier scores, and ensemble scores as separate fields.
  • Compare search methods under matched expansion, token, verifier, embedding, and wall-clock budgets.
  • Treat the repository's toy JSONL and benchmark gains as implementation/system evidence, not proof of a complete high-quality rollout release.

• 区分原始推理状态、聚类后的超节点与最终选中轨迹；三者是不同数据对象。
  • 审计状态对标签与错误合并，尤其关注数字、运算符或假设改变但文本仍相似的情形。
  • 将 Monte Carlo 目标、调整后 TD(λ) 目标、单个 verifier 分数与集成分数分别保存。
  • 在扩展次数、token、verifier、嵌入与墙钟预算一致的条件下比较搜索方法。
  • 将仓库 toy JSONL 与基准提升视为实现/系统证据，而不是完整高质量 rollout 发布的证明。
